subject: Tidal-Mini variant: governance review, compat checks, and temporary pin request
thread_content:
--- Message 1 (original) ---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tidal-Mini variant onboarding: short governance summary + pin ask

Hi team,

We're kicking off intake for a new upstream variant from Reef Labs (Tidal-Mini 3.2). Key points up front:

- Customer/prospect: Reef Labs — interested in switching their classification pipeline to Tidal-Mini due to cost/latency improvements.
- Why we're asking for a pin: the variant uses a nonstandard tokenizer and a 4-bit quant profile that produced small but consistent shift in short-answer recall during evals. We want a temporary, limited pin while we validate telemetry in production.
- Risk profile: medium (possible short-term quality regression for a subset of prompts, small perf memory increase).

Attachments: tidal-mini-summary.pdf (model notes) and tidal-mini-perf-matrix.csv (eval numbers).

Asks:
1) Approve a short-term pin (2 weeks) on the hosted catalog while we run a canary and collect production telemetry.
2) Dev to confirm binary/op compatibility on our runtime; list any non-backward-compatible ops.
3) Security to do a quick third-party claims review and confirm there are no restricted data-flow issues.

Would like a decision this week if possible — Reef wants staging access next Tuesday.

Thanks,
Marissa
---
Marissa Cole
Product Manager, Model Onboarding
Redwood Inference
---

--- Message 2 (reply) ---
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 10:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Tidal-Mini variant onboarding: short governance summary + pin ask

Thanks Marissa — good summary. A couple quick clarifications before we move to an approval: 

- Can you paste the short perf delta (p50/p95 latency, memory) in-line? I have the attachments but want the highlights in the thread for visibility.
- If Dev confirms runtime compatibility and Rishi gives the all-clear on security, I'm okay with a limited pin, but prefer 3 weeks rather than 2 so we have time to capture usage variance.

Dev — please surface any kernel/op incompatibilities and estimated effort to add fallbacks.

I'll set up a short sync Tuesday 11am PT to walk through the rollout plan with the account lead and Reef.

- Logan
---

--- Message 3 (reply) ---
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 13:30:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Tidal-Mini variant onboarding: short governance summary + pin ask

On Mon, Aug 16, 2027 at 9:12 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> We're kicking off intake for a new upstream variant from Reef Labs (Tidal-Mini 3.2).

Quick compatibility check summary (runtime):

- Ops: No novel ops; tokenizer differences are handled at pre/post-processing layer.
- Memory: ~+5% peak memory for batching patterns with long-prefix KV (observed in our perf matrix).
- Latency: p50/p95 comparable to our baseline when run with the recommended quant profile; p99 shows +8-12ms in heavy concurrency.
- KV cache: minor layout change; requires a small compatibility shim that we can enable via a runtime flag.

Recommendation: we can serve Tidal-Mini with the following constraints:
- Temporary pin: 3 weeks (matches Logan's ask).
- Canary: start at 0.5% traffic, increase to 1% after 48h if metrics are green.
- Fallback variant: route to Tidal-Mini-CompatV0 (our internal compat build) if errors or latency > 2x baseline.
- Telemetry keys to monitor: latency_p50, latency_p95, error_rate, kv_miss_rate, hallucination_detector_score.

I'll add the runtime flag and the shim; should be low-effort (1-2 engineer-days). I'll attach a short runbook in the Drive link.

- Dev
---

--- Message 4 (reply) ---
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tidal-Mini variant onboarding: short governance summary + pin ask

Thanks — I reviewed the third-party claims doc (attached: third-party-claims.docx). Quick notes:

- No known data exfiltration vectors in the variant itself. The model vendor uses standard licensing and has no embedded telemetry.
- KMS: Reef uses a supported KMS provider; integration looks fine from a cryptography perspective.
- Requirements: before we flip customer traffic to the pinned variant we need:
  * SOC2 evidence from Reef (or a SOC2 gap remediation plan).
  * Confirmation of retention policy for inference logs (we need ephemeral or customer-specific retention configured).
  * A short runtime access review for the reviewer list (legal + security) — I'll start the intake.

If those are satisfied, security is comfortable with the temporary pin + canary.

- Rishi
---

--- Message 5 (decision) ---
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Tidal-Mini variant onboarding: short governance summary + pin ask

Decision: APPROVED (conditional)

Conditions:
- Temporary pin duration: 3 weeks from the date of canary start.
- Canary rollout: 0.5% -> 1% after 48h if no regressions.
- Required evidence before moving to higher traffic: SOC2 proof or written remediation plan; inference log retention set to ephemeral per-account unless customer explicitly requests otherwise and signs amendments.
- Telemetry gating: automatic rollback if latency_p95 > 2x baseline OR error_rate > 0.5% sustained over 15m OR hallucination_detector_score increases by >5% versus baseline.
- Legal: finalize a short addendum for the Reef engagement documenting the pin and data retention terms.

Marissa — please coordinate with the account rep and Reef to collect SOC2 or remediation plan and confirm timeline. Dev — proceed with the runtime flag and the canary runbook. Rishi — continue the security intake and close the access review.

I'll join the Tuesday 11am sync to confirm the canary plan.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

--- End of thread ---
